hero.name: Omkar
hero.intro: We might have crossed paths somewhere, and honestly a biodata or a profile doesn't say much about anyone. So I made this page instead. Have a look, it won't take long.
hero.photoAlt: Omkar laughing at a dinner table

story.title:
A bit
about me.
story.blurb: Scroll slowly. Each part has a photo.

chapters.title: I build AI tools at IBM.
chapters.body: I'm a Development Lead in AI Tooling at IBM. Building things was my hobby first, and then <mark>it became my job</mark>. I still enjoy it, which I think is lucky. Mostly I take messy problems and try to make something that actually works.

chapters.title: From Pune, living in Bengaluru.
chapters.body: I grew up in Maharashtra and moved to Bengaluru for work. I speak Marathi and English, and my Kannada is <mark>still a work in progress</mark>. During festivals I miss home a bit more.

chapters.title: Trying to stay fit.
chapters.body: I go to the gym and try to be regular about it. Some days the workout goes well, some days I just show up. <mark>Showing up is the main thing.</mark>

chapters.alt: Omkar with a red sports bike
chapters.title: Still a bit of young blood.
chapters.body: I like trying new things. New ideas, <mark>new side projects</mark>, sometimes something a little risky. At any point I have too many tabs open, in the browser and in my head.

chapters.alt: A dinner table with food and a lamp
chapters.title: Good food, good people.
chapters.body: My idea of a good evening is simple. Nice food, a few good people, and <mark>a conversation that goes on for two hours</mark> without anyone noticing.

chapters.alt: Omkar in a cowboy hat and a colourful costume
chapters.title: I like seeing how others live.
chapters.body: I like people who are curious and kind, and who can <mark>laugh at small things</mark>. When I travel I like trying the local stuff, and yes, sometimes that includes wearing it.

quotes.title:
A few things
I believe in.
quotes.blurb: Picked up from books, life, and one YouTube comment section.

items.text: Better to be a dissatisfied human than a satisfied pig.
Passion is a myth. Run behind your curiosities.
items.by: Someone in a YouTube comment section, lol

travel.statement: I like my work. But every three or four months I get burnt out, and then I pack a bag and go somewhere.
travel.sub: I'm not a photographer. These are just phone photos from those trips that came out nice.

scenes.alt: Whitewashed buildings above a mountain valley in Ladakh
scenes.title: Not Greece, I promise.
scenes.caption: White walls, brown mountains, and the bluest sky I have seen.

scenes.alt: Varkala beach from the cliff top
scenes.title: Cliffs and sea.
scenes.caption: Went for an hour, stayed till sunset.

scenes.alt: A canoe on a narrow canal on Munroe Island
scenes.title: Backwaters by canoe.
scenes.caption: Narrow canals, coconut trees, and no hurry at all.

scenes.alt: Sunset over the hills of Vagamon
scenes.title: Sunset in the hills.
scenes.caption: Very quiet place. That was the whole point.

scenes.alt: Sunlit sea from the Varkala cliffs
scenes.title: Varkala, again.
scenes.caption: Same place, different day. Phone stayed on silent.

hello.title: If you've read till here, let's talk.
paragraphs: I'm looking for a partner who is open-minded, doesn't judge people, and treats everyone with kindness. Someone ambitious, who still has dreams, even if we can't fulfil all of them. We don't need to have everything in common. If we're both curious about each other, that's a good start.
If you want to talk, just send a hello. No need for a perfect first message.
